tools.name: gomry_search_events
tools.description: Search the public Gomry catalogue of events and experiences by free-text query — for example "salsa classes in Miami this weekend" or "tech conferences". Returns public listings with name, date, location, price and a link. Read-only; returns nothing private and requires no sign-in.

query.description: What to search for. A natural-language phrase works best — include the city and any timeframe in the phrase itself rather than as separate fields.

limit.description: Maximum listings to return (1-30). Defaults to 10.
